news.author: Jim Callis

news.title: Sources: Bauers parlays career season into 4-year, $58M contract with Red Sox
news.summary: First baseman Jake Bauers, who is coming off a career season with the Brewers, has agreed to a four-year, $58M contract with the Red Sox, sources told ESPN.

news.title: Blue Jays' Santander apologizes for sharing anti-Muslim posts
news.summary: Blue Jays outfielder Anthony Santander apologized for sharing anti-Muslim social media posts, saying it caused hurt and fell short of his own convictions.

news.title: Angels, catcher Heineman avoid arbitration with 1-year deal
news.summary: Veteran catcher Tyler Heineman and the Los Angeles Angels have agreed to a one-year contract for $1,237,500, the same salary he made this year.

news.title: Cubs' Crow-Armstrong, Astros' Alvarez sweep votes as unanimous MVP winners
news.summary: Cubs star Pete Crow-Armstrong and the Astros' Yordan Alvarez each earned all 30 first-place votes to win the MVP awards in their respective leagues Thursday night.

news.title: Braves bolster bullpen, reach 3-year, $35 million deal with Phillips
news.summary: The Braves and free agent relief pitcher Evan Phillips, who appeared in 31 games for the Dodgers last season, have agreed to a three-year, $35 million contract.

news.title: Brewers' Misiorowski, Yanks' Schlittler crowned unanimous Cy Young winners
news.summary: Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski and New York's Cam Schlittler capped dominant 2026 seasons by sweeping all 30 first-place votes to win their respective Cy Young Awards.

news.title: Ausmus dismisses 'glory days,' wants Astros to win World Series 'every single year'
news.summary: New Astros manager Brad Ausmus said he's "not here to talk about glory days" after playing for the franchise and is instead focused on winning the World Series.
